;Arts and culture

[https://abcnews.go.com/International/french-prime-minister-announces-competition-rebuild-notre-dame/story?id=62453875 (ABC News)] [https://www.masslive.com/news/2019/04/after-notre-dame-fire-french-prime-minister-announces-international-architects-competition-to-rebuild-spire.html (MassLive)]

;Business and economy
*[[Singapore]]'s non-oil exports slumped in March, according to numbers released by [[Enterprise Singapore]]. This was the biggest year-on-year monthly drop since October 2016. The slump in the export of electronics was especially marked. [https://www.straitstimes.com/business/economy/singapore-non-oil-exports-fall-117-in-march-the-biggest-drop-in-more-than-2-years (''The Straits Times'')] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Madeira bus crash]]
**At least 29 people, all [[Germans|German]] tourists, are killed in a bus crash in [[Caniço (Santa Cruz)|Caniço]], [[Madeira Islands]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-47969994 (BBC News)]
*At least fourteen people are killed and 15 others are injured after a bus lost control and collided with a stationary truck in [[Solwezi District]], [[Zambia]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/africa/2019-04/18/c_137988003.htm (Xinhuanet)]

;Law and crime
*[[Operation Car Wash#Peru|Operation Car Wash § Peru]]
**Former [[President of Peru|Peruvian President]] [[Alan García]] dies from a self-inflicted gunshot wound. The incident happened moments after judicial authorities had served him with an arrest warrant on corruption charges. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/17/americas/alan-garcia-peru-shoots-himself-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.infobae.com/america/america-latina/2019/04/17/el-ex-presidente-peruano-alan-garcia-se-disparo-en-la-cabeza-tras-recibir-una-orden-de-arresto-y-esta-en-grave-estado/ (Infobae)]
*Schools in the [[Denver]], Colorado, metropolitan area are closed as the FBI searched for an 18-year-old [[Miami Beach Senior High School]] student described as "infatuated" with the [[Columbine High School massacre]]. She traveled to Colorado and purchased a shotgun and ammunition upon arriving, and was deemed a "credible threat" to area schools. She was later confirmed dead. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/17/us/columbine-threat-search-for-woman/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/crime-courts/woman-sought-denver-area-schools-lockout-following-serious-threat-n995256 (NBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/17/us/columbine-shooting-sol-pais.html (''The New York Times'')]
*Moroccan authorities arrest a jihadist preparing to commit a terrorist attack in [[Seville]], [[Spain]], during the [[Holy Week]] processions. [https://elpais.com/politica/2019/04/17/actualidad/1555507252_051582.html (''El País'')]
*Aftermath of the [[2019 Sudanese coup d'état]]
**Former [[President of Sudan]] [[Omar al-Bashir]] is transferred  from [[house arrest]] to a maximum security prison, reports say. His whereabouts had been unknown since the coup against him earlier this month. Al-Bashir has been wanted by the [[International Criminal Court]] since 2009 for war crimes in [[Darfur]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-47961424 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
**Presidential candidate {{Interlanguage link|Mario Estrada|es}} is captured in the [[United States]] because of his alleged connections with the international drug trafficking [[Sinaloa Cartel]]. The [[United States Department of Justice]] says in a statement that Estrada had requested the murder of political rivals to win the presidency in exchange for granting control of airports and ports in the country to these groups. The presidential and parliamentary elections are scheduled for June 16. [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/mario-estrada-es-detenido-en-estados-unidos-por-nexos-con-narcotrafico/ (''Prensa Libre'')]
*A man carrying lighters, canisters filled with gasoline and lighter fluid is arrested at [[New York City]]'s [[St. Patrick's Cathedral (New York City)|St. Patrick's Cathedral]]. A police source states Lamparello is a [[City University of New York|CUNY]] student seeking his Ph.D. in philosophy and occasional adjunct lecturer at [[Lehman College]]. [https://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/news/439472-man-arrested-with-gasoline-lighter-fluid-at-new-yorks-st (''The Hill'')] [https://nypost.com/2019/04/17/man-arrested-after-walking-into-st-patricks-cathedral-with-gas-cans/ (''New York Post'')]

*[[2019 Indonesian general election]]
**Voters in Indonesia go to the polls to elect members of the [[People's Consultative Assembly|parliament]], the [[President of Indonesia|President]] and [[Vice President of Indonesia|Vice President]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/17/indonesias-biggest-ever-election-under-way-as-193-million-march-to-polls (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Yale University]] researchers led by professor [[Nenad Sestan]] announce, through the ''[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]'' journal, that they successfully partly revived the brains of deceased [[pig]]s, four hours after death occurred. However, there were no signals from the brains that would indicate awareness or consciousness. [https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2019/04/17/714289322/scientists-restore-some-function-in-the-brains-of-dead-pigs (NPR)]
